scripts.test:e2e:stop-server: sh -c 'pid=$(lsof -tiTCP:8000 -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -n "$pid" ]; then kill $pid; fi'
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run test:e2e:stop-server && PW_USE_SWIFTSHADER=0 playwright test --headed --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:debug: npm run test:e2e:stop-server && PW_USE_SWIFTSHADER=0 playwright test --debug
scripts.test:e2e:local: npm run test:e2e:stop-server && sh -c 'xvfb-run -a npx playwright test --headed --workers=1 --reporter=line 2>&1 | tee test_output.txt'
